questions.question: How did Rika become a curse spirit bound to Yuta?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu/Synopsis

answer.item: Rika was killed by a street accident, Yuta then accidentally uttered her name which subconsciously cursed her soul to remain with him and turn into a vengeful curse spirit.

questions.question: Why did Yuta isolate himself while growing up?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu/Synopsis

answer.item: While growing up, Rika would harm the tormentors, causing Yuta to isolate himself in order to protect people from being killed.

questions.question: Why did the Tokyo Jujutsu College take Yuta to be executed?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuta is involved in an incident where four students who were bullying him, were seriously injured, having been crammed in a locker badly (which was caused by Rika who was protecting him). The Tokyo Jujutsu College notices that Yuta is cursed with a special graded curse, and takes him to be executed

questions.question: Why was Yuta's curse on Rika so powerful?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu/Synopsis

answer.item: Gojo also explains that Yuta is a distant relative of the sorcerer, Michizane Sugawara (which meant that he was distantly related to Gojo), which accounts for the unprecedented strength of the curse he was able to place on Rika at her death.

questions.question: What did Gojo say about Yuta's potential?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu/Synopsis

answer.item: Gojo mentions to Ichiji that he believes Yuta is one of the few students who have the potential to someday surpass him, alongside Yuji Itadori and the third-year student, Kinji Hakari.

questions.question: Why did Yuta say he would kill Yuji himself?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuta asks them if he should enter into a Binding Vow with them and states he doesn't care if Yuji Itadori is Gojo's pupil because he was responsible for cutting off Toge Inumaki's arm in Shibuya. Yuta then says he will kill Yuji Itadori himself.

questions.question: Why did Yuta enter a Binding Vow to 'kill' Yuji?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuta also tells Yuji that in order for the jujutsu higherups to approve of Yuta being Yuji's executioner, he had to go into a Binding Vow with them to "kill" him.

questions.question: What did Tengen reveal about the sorcerer who calls herself an angel?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu/Synopsis

answer.item: Tengen reveals that among the players participating in the Culling Game, there is a sorcerer from 1,000 years ago who calls herself an angel and that her cursed technique can extinguish any cursed technique.

questions.question: How did Yuta manage to kill Kenjaku?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuta then decides to act on the plan to kill Kenjaku while he is distracted by Fumihiko Takaba, with the help of Aoi Todo's Boogie Woogie, successfully managed to decapitate the sorcerer.

questions.question: What was the final resort plan Yuta asked Shoko to enact?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu/Synopsis

answer.item: At headquarters Yuta is treated for his wounds that are fatal only maintaining consciousness due to Rika, he tells Shoko to enact on their final resort plan, she tells him once his brain is placed into Gojo's body to use his reverse cursed technique at maximum.

questions.question: What position did Yuta hold by 2035?
questions.subject: Yuta Okkotsu/Synopsis

answer.item: By year 2035, Yuta became the head representative of the Gojo Clan, and acquired ownership of Panda following his loss of activity.
